description: Use this only after the user says they completed (or want to reopen) a specific step from leakdata.action_plan, for example "I changed my Canva password". Pass that step's stepId from leakdata.action_plan and done=true, or done=false to reopen it; if no action plan result in this conversation contains the step, call leakdata.action_plan first. Saves the change to the user's LeakData action plan; it does not change anything on the breached site. A request to mark all or several steps done is not confirmation: ask which steps the user actually finished and call this once per confirmed step. Never guess a stepId.

done.description: true when the user finished the step, false to reopen it.

name: leakdata.mark_step_done
title: Mark a step done
